items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: The interviewee describes Bunk playing at 'Ryan's' (a venue) and mentions other musicians (Lips Page, Willie the Lion) present, but does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with a person named Ryan.

ctx.x: He had been guilty. But he says, how come you never mentioned it to me before? Apparently Bunk never mentioned it to me the whole Boston thing. Yeah. It's a matter he didn't throw it up there when they were arguing all the time.

I had a lot of trouble up there. Is there anything else about any of the other nights that you remember going around with Bunk to hear music or anyplace else that you ran across him? Not necessarily at Lessons or at the Stuyvesant or someplace where he was playing while you're in this groove about like Ryan's or anyplace else. Do you remember Bunk coming in or Harlem or anyplace else?

I remember Bunk playing at Ryan's, playing beautifully at Ryan's. It was a session, I think it was one of the sessions, the Sunday sessions that Lips Page was usually playing and Bunk came in to sit in. And I remember Lips was standing at the bar and was completely moved. Bunk was playing so beautifully and Lips really did love the way Bunk played, you know. And he wouldn't even play. He wouldn't even get on the bandstand. He says, that's the man, you know. He says, I don't want to play. And it was very good. I…
